scope: Authoritative read-only Shadow comparison contract for the WBS742 direct object-domain projections consumed by WBS743. It defines Gate 1-3 contracts and fixtures, the Gate 4 provider, and isolated MariaDB Gate 5 verification.

domainDerivation.rule: domains are exactly object-domain-import-field-map.v1.json mappings[].domain in source order; canonical tables are exactly each mapping.targetTables; migration ownership is derived from object-domain-import-target-schema.v1.json columns[].migration

rules: Resolve legacy source locators through persisted WBS731/WBS742 identity bindings and the WBS743 player crosswalk before comparing rows.
Never cast a legacy BIGINT actor or registry id to a canonical CHAR(8) key.
Never infer identity from display name, nickname, array proximity, or mutable presentation fields.
Unresolved, ambiguous, duplicate, or payload-drifted bindings are mismatches and are quarantined before comparison.

executionRules.lockPolicy: No explicit or implicit write lock, advisory lock, lease acquisition, claim transition, or SELECT FOR UPDATE is allowed.
executionRules.writePolicy: No legacy JSON, canonical row, import ledger, audit row, outbox row, receipt, quarantine table, migration, schema, or operational snapshot may be written.
executionRules.environmentPolicy: Gate 1-3 validation uses only the committed synthetic fixture and read-only contract/migration inspection. Production JSON, production DB, real room traffic, and feature/prod are out of scope.
executionRules.writerSelection: Neither LEGACY nor MODERN writer is invoked. Shadow adapters project already-observed read snapshots only.
executionRules.failurePolicy: Fail closed and suppress promotion on any mismatch, missing prerequisite, mutation evidence, or repeatability drift.

implemented: deterministic canonical row comparison and ephemeral mismatch output
identity, row, multiplicity, field, Unicode, BIGINT, reference closure, table coverage, restart drift, and mutation-evidence classification
limitations: The provider receives already-projected legacy rows and does not replace the WBS742 projection importer.
Mutation fingerprints are caller-supplied at Gate 4 and are not an isolated MariaDB before/after proof; that proof belongs to Gate 5.

gate5VerificationEvidence.database: fresh isolated MariaDB 12.2 on loopback port 3326
limitations: Only committed synthetic relational data was used.
This is an isolated Gate 5 proof, not an approved operational Shadow observation window or cutover proof.

canonicalization.objectKeys: sort recursively by Unicode scalar value; do not use locale collation
canonicalization.arrays: preserve declared array order; row collections must first be sorted by table and the domain oracle identityKey
canonicalization.unicodeStrings: serialize exact Unicode scalar sequences as UTF-8 JSON; do not NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD normalize, case-fold, trim, or rewrite emoji/variation selectors
canonicalization.bigint: represent every BIGINT or BIGINT UNSIGNED value as {"$bigint":"<canonical decimal>"}; decimal is -?(0|[1-9][0-9]*), forbids -0, leading plus, leading zero, exponent, float, and JavaScript Number conversion
canonicalization.undefined: forbidden; absence and JSON null are distinct
canonicalization.digest: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes

gate3ClassifierSupport.limitation: Gate 3 supplies classification evidence only for implemented. gate4Required categories are taxonomy reservations with no current classifier execution evidence.

quarantinePolicy.payloadPolicy: Store hashes and synthetic locators only; never copy operational payloads or identifying source keys.
quarantinePolicy.resolution: No automatic merge, fallback, default, or display-name reconciliation. A later gate must supply a reviewed resolution and rerun the full domain.
quarantinePolicy.promotionRule: Any quarantine count greater than zero blocks Gate 7 completion.

restartRepeatability.procedure: Run the same sealed input twice in fresh adapter state and stable domain order; both canonical projection digests, mismatch categories, and quarantine records must be byte-identical.
restartRepeatability.clockPolicy: Wall-clock time, process id, random value, DB row-return order, and insertion order are excluded from the comparison payload.
restartRepeatability.passCondition: firstRunDigest equals restartRunDigest and both runs report zero mutation.

requiredSurfaces: legacy snapshot if a later gate is approved
canonical DB if a later gate is approved
zeroMutationProof.fileProof: Capture SHA-256 and byte length before and after; every pair must match.
zeroMutationProof.databaseProof: Gate 5 captures all base-table schema metadata, row counts, CHECKSUM TABLE values, and side-effect table counts before and after both Shadow runs using a SELECT-only DB identity; every value is unchanged.
zeroMutationProof.gate1To3Limitation: Gate 1-3 alone did not prove a DB session; Gate 5 now supplies that isolated MariaDB proof.

gate6: Integrate every WBS743 consumer family only after its canonical provider is complete.
Prove per-consumer legacy/canonical output parity, ordering, bigint exactness, Unicode byte preservation, transaction non-participation, and restart replay.
gate7: Execute the approved Shadow observation window with no legacy or canonical writer invocation by the comparator.
Require zero unresolved quarantine, stable restart digests, no mutations, complete domain/consumer coverage, commit/push evidence, and foreman ACK before claiming Shadow complete.
